name: xray
description: Amazon Web Services X-Ray provides APIs for managing debug traces and retrieving service maps and other data created by processing those traces.

subcommands.name: batch-get-traces
subcommands.description: You cannot find traces through this API if Transaction Search is enabled since trace is not indexed in X-Ray.

subcommands.name: cancel-trace-retrieval
subcommands.description: Cancels an ongoing trace retrieval job initiated by StartTraceRetrieval using the provided RetrievalToken.

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a group resource with a name and a filter expression.

subcommands.name: create-sampling-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a rule to control sampling behavior for instrumented applications.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a group resource.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource policy from the target Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-sampling-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a sampling rule.

subcommands.name: get-encryption-config
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current encryption configuration for X-Ray data.

subcommands.name: get-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves group resource details.

subcommands.name: get-groups
subcommands.description: Retrieves all active group details.

subcommands.name: get-indexing-rules
subcommands.description: Retrieves all indexing rules.

subcommands.name: get-insight
subcommands.description: Retrieves the summary information of an insight.

subcommands.name: get-insight-events
subcommands.description: X-Ray reevaluates insights periodically until they're resolved, and records each intermediate state as an event.

subcommands.name: get-insight-impact-graph
subcommands.description: Retrieves a service graph structure filtered by the specified insight.

subcommands.name: get-insight-summaries
subcommands.description: Retrieves the summaries of all insights in the specified group matching the provided filter values.

subcommands.name: get-retrieved-traces-graph
subcommands.description: Retrieves a service graph for traces based on the specified RetrievalToken from the CloudWatch log group generated by Transaction Search.

subcommands.name: get-sampling-rules
subcommands.description: Retrieves all sampling rules.

subcommands.name: get-sampling-statistic-summaries
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about recent sampling results for all sampling rules.

subcommands.name: get-sampling-targets
subcommands.description: Requests a sampling quota for rules that the service is using to sample requests.

subcommands.name: get-service-graph
subcommands.description: Retrieves a document that describes services that process incoming requests, and downstream services that they call as a result.

subcommands.name: get-time-series-service-statistics
subcommands.description: Get an aggregation of service statistics defined by a specific time range.

subcommands.name: get-trace-graph
subcommands.description: Retrieves a service graph for one or more specific trace IDs.

subcommands.name: get-trace-segment-destination
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current destination of data sent to PutTraceSegments and OpenTelemetry protocol (OTLP) endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-trace-summaries
subcommands.description: Retrieves IDs and annotations for traces available for a specified time frame using an optional filter.

subcommands.name: list-resource-policies
subcommands.description: Returns the list of resource policies in the target Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-retrieved-traces
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of traces for a given RetrievalToken from the CloudWatch log group generated by Transaction Search.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags that are applied to the specified Amazon Web Services X-Ray group or sampling rule.

subcommands.name: put-encryption-config
subcommands.description: Updates the encryption configuration for X-Ray data.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Sets the resource policy to grant one or more Amazon Web Services services and accounts permissions to access X-Ray.

subcommands.name: put-telemetry-records
subcommands.description: Used by the Amazon Web Services X-Ray daemon to upload telemetry.

subcommands.name: put-trace-segments
subcommands.description: Uploads segment documents to Amazon Web Services X-Ray.

subcommands.name: start-trace-retrieval
subcommands.description: Initiates a trace retrieval process using the specified time range and for the given trace IDs in the Transaction Search generated CloudWatch log group.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies tags to an existing Amazon Web Services X-Ray group or sampling rule.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon Web Services X-Ray group or sampling rule.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Updates a group resource.

subcommands.name: update-indexing-rule
subcommands.description: Modifies an indexing rule’s configuration.

subcommands.name: update-sampling-rule
subcommands.description: Modifies a sampling rule's configuration.

subcommands.name: update-trace-segment-destination
subcommands.description: Modifies the destination of data sent to PutTraceSegments.
